svg.title: Computation graph for f = x² y sin x + 2 y² cos x
svg.desc: Nine nodes with forward values in blue and backward gradients in red at x = 1, y = 2; the four paths out of x add to -2.28528 and the two paths out of y add to 5.16389.
svg.text: f = x² y sin x + 2 y² cos x at x = 1, y = 2
blue: forward value. red: g = ∂f/∂(node), filled right to left. Edge numbers: what each path out of x (purple) or y (green)
